steps.en: Vehicle category codes come from REPCCS
steps.id: Kode kategori kendaraan diambil dari REPCCS
steps.why_en: The codes are kept in the OCMS own database and are not fetched from REPCCS.
steps.why_id: Kode disimpan di database OCMS sendiri dan tidak diambil dari REPCCS.

steps.en: Car park codes and names come from REPCCS
steps.id: Kode dan nama car park diambil dari REPCCS
steps.why_en: Car parks are read from a shared database, not received from REPCCS; its source cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Car park dibaca dari database bersama, bukan diterima dari REPCCS; sumbernya belum bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: Operator IDs are obtained from REPCCS
steps.why_en: No code fetches a list of operator IDs; only one ID per received notice is saved.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang mengambil daftar ID operator; hanya satu ID per notice yang diterima disimpan.

steps.en: Vehicle category is chosen from a drop-down
Car park code and name are chosen from drop-downs
steps.id: Kode dan nama car park dipilih dari drop-down

steps.en: Operator ID is chosen from a drop-down
steps.why_en: The operator drop-down is an empty placeholder and is switched off in the form.
steps.why_id: Drop-down operator hanya kerangka kosong dan dimatikan di form.
